scheme_name: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a dependent of people in occupations traditionally considered untouchable.
Students cannot receive other scholarships alongside this one (with some exceptions).
All children of the applicant's parents are eligible.
Applicants must be studying in class 9 or 10.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance ranging from ₹3,500 to ₹8,000 per annum depending on student type and component (day vs. residential).
